title: Workbench, Scenario Packs, Balance & Cross-Scale Golden Proof
objective: Implement a visibility-first deterministic read-only SCL workbench, scenario-pack reference model, evidence-based balance review, and cross-scale golden proof over completed SCL-01..10 without reopening or mutating frozen owner-domain mechanics.

rules: Scenario packs are immutable reference bundles over explicit existing SCL-01..10 definitions, results and owner references; they do not execute orders, combat, casualties or strategic consequences.

Workbench projections are read-only and authorization filters before scenario references, counts, scale coverage, search, provenance, comparisons, receipts or AI context; hidden existence/cardinality is undisclosed.
Workbench operations are browse, inspect, compare, validate and proposal-reference only; no operation mutates canonical SCL or owner-domain state.

Balance is evidence review, not a new mechanical owner. Reviews may be evidence-supported, owner-review-required or insufficient-evidence and must retain explicit evidence/context/reference provenance.

No universal power score, encounter rating, fairness equation, force-equivalence formula, automatic balance threshold or cross-scale conversion formula is source-authorized; SCL-11 must not invent one.

Cross-scale golden proof verifies explicit fixtures across individual, squad, unit, formation, force and theater while preserving stable constituent identities, source/result references, owner references, visibility and provenance.

Golden proof covers completed SCL-01..10 contracts by explicit reference and may produce deterministic proof receipts only; it never synthesizes missing predecessor results or re-runs owner-domain mechanics as a new authority.
Unknown, conflict, incompatible or insufficient evidence stays conservative and is never guessed, auto-approved or AI-reconciled.
Stable IDs/orderings and deterministic receipts are required; deterministic ordering creates no authority or priority.
Successful proof does not canonize a scenario, change balance rules, execute a battle, commit consequences, grant release authority or authorize MAL-01.

invalidation_events: required validation reports a materially new failure signature

validation_requirement: Exactly one SCL-11 current-family profile, zero historical predecessor fanout, genuine matching self-hosted Linux/Windows acceptance RED before production mutation, then exact-head Linux/Windows GREEN and deterministic comparison.
